_meta: Per-show minimum scored reviews for showing a Critic Score, overriding the market minimum (and the T3-only extra). Owner-approved exceptions only; each entry names who approved it and why. Read by scoreGateArg() in src/config/scoring.ts and scripts/lib/should-hide-reviews.js (BRO-7750). keptMarketMinimum records an owner decision to keep the market minimum for a special or short run (no effect on the site; it answers the 'Press night: score gate undecided' health row, BRO-7779).
